setup: CREATE TABLE ordered AS SELECT i, 49999-i AS k FROM range(50000) t(i)

workloads.name: ordered_aggregate_ungrouped
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(i ORDER BY k), first(i ORDER BY k), last(i ORDER BY k) FROM ordered

workloads.name: ordered_aggregate_grouped
workloads.sql: SELECT first(i ORDER BY k), last(i ORDER BY k) FROM ordered GROUP BY i%64
